project.name: Client portal
project.summary: Clients log in, see their documents, and get status updates — so email back-and-forth stops.

deploys.note: Clients can reset their own password now

features.name: Login page
features.oneLiner: Clients sign in with email and password.

stories.title: Sign in with email and password
See a clear message when the password is wrong
Stay signed in for a week
stories.note: Built and checked — waiting to go out with the next deploy.
stories.unsure: Checked on Chrome and Safari, not yet on older phones.

decisions.what: Email and password only for launch; social login parked.

features.name: Document viewer
features.oneLiner: Clients open and download their PDFs inside the portal.

stories.title: See a list of my documents
Preview a PDF without downloading it
stories.note: Back in Building — large files loaded too slowly in testing. Nothing is lost.

Must handle files up to 50MB before it goes to prod.

unsure: The whole feature has only been tried with our own test account.

features.name: Status updates
features.oneLiner: Clients see a simple timeline of where their project stands.

needsYou.title: Ready to go to prod
